messages:
Maria: CI red on nightly-gpu-2 (h100). failing test is tests/inference/test_attention.py::test_long_context intermittently with OOM + kernel panic logs. repro started ~3 runs in a row. https://ci.example.com/build/4021 :sad-panda:

InfraBot: job 4021 failed on shard 5. logs: https://ci.example.com/build/4021/logs. Attached system message: `Xid 79: GPU kernel timeout`

Jason: thanks — any recent driver rollouts on the pool? or new images?

Lee: rolled driver 535.54 -> 536.10 yesterday to canaries. only ~20% of h100s on canary. but allocator metrics spiked on some hosts. cc @Maria

Maria: hmm saw a stack with `invalid device function` in libcudart stack too. could be PTX/JIT mismatch.

Anya: I can kick a rerun on the failed shard + run with `--cuda-debug` to capture kernel launch params. want a bisect?

Jason: yes please rerun on both canary and stable hosts. if can reproduce only on canary then driver likely culprit. if on both, maybe model kernel change.

Anya: kickoff: `ci rerun --job 4021 --shard 5 --tags canary,stable --env CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 --extra-args "--collect-cuda-logs"`

InfraBot: rerun queued: https://ci.example.com/build/4021/retry/1 (canary) and .../retry/2 (stable).

(10m later)

Anya: results in. canary run failed with same OOM + Xid79. stable run passed. canary host logs show driver 536.10, kernel module reports `ptxJIT: unsupported sm 90 code` warnings.

Lee: that matches hypothesis — JIT compiled PTX targeting unsupported SM for that driver combo. maybe new nvcc or toolchain produced different cubin fallbacks.

Jason: ok looks like rollout is the likely cause. next steps: rollback canary to 535.54, or pin job routing away from canary until we patch.

Maria: can we bisect which package introduced the PTX change? cc @Anya — do we have image hashes for recent builds?

Anya: I'll do a quick image diff. preliminary found different `torch` wheel build id between images (2026-03-01 vs 2026-03-05). scheduling a narrower rerun with old/new wheel.

Lee: also file an infra incident so SRE can pause the driver rollout. I'll start the rollback if confirmed.

Maria: thanks all. please add minimal repro snippet to the ticket when you have it. copying logs to internal ticket: INFRA-1189.
